(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP2023)
CLASS:  BTECH   SEMESTER : VI
BRANCH: CS/IT/ECE/EEE   SESSION : SP2023

SUBJECT: MT204 CONSTITUTION OF INDIA
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1(a) Illustrate the significance of constitution.   [2] 1 4
Q.1(b) Interpret the Preamble. Explain its importance for Indian Republic.  [3] 1 2


Q.2(a) Explain how India is a republic?  [2] 1 8
Q.2(b) Defend the statement that ‘Right to Freedom’ is one of the most important fundamental
rights of Indian citizen?
[3] 2 9


Q.3(a) Describe Fundamental Right against Exploitation.  [2] 2 5
Q.3(b) Distinguish fundamental rights and directive principles. [3] 2 1


Q.4(a) What are the three tiers of the union council of ministers.  [2] 4 1
Q.4(b) Appraise the collective responsibility of council of ministers? [3] 4 9


Q.5(a) Explain the election process of the President of India? [2] 4 8
Q.5(b) Describe the constitutional powers of the President of India. [3] 4 5
